items.name: Core
items.task: See your business and every venue, every day

shot.alt: VILAX key metrics on demo data: sales, food cost, gross profit, guests and average check

features.title: Live revenue and checks
features.text: Revenue across your venues by the hour, with an end-of-day forecast and a comparison with a typical day.

features.title: Key metrics
features.text: Revenue, food cost, gross profit, guests, average check and discounts, against the previous period.

features.title: Actual vs target
features.text: Daily targets that follow weekdays and seasonality, the gap to target and a month-end forecast for every location.

features.title: Location rankings
features.text: Locations grouped into normal, attention and risk by revenue, trend, food cost, discounts and average check.

features.title: Shift review
features.text: Yesterday's shift against target, a typical day and its potential at normal spend per guest.

features.title: Shift team
features.text: Results for every team member: tables, guests, revenue per table and per guest, losses.

items.name: Guests 360
items.task: Run the guest journey from first inquiry to the next visit

features.title: Tables and orders
features.text: The server's screen: floor tables, open orders and what is on them.

items.name: Finance & Control
items.task: See where each restaurant makes money and where it leaks

shot.alt: VILAX loss summary on demo data: six loss channels and staff above their usual level

features.title: Profit & loss
features.text: P&L for the business and each venue by week, month or quarter.

features.title: Cash flow
features.text: Money in and out across the business, by line and by venue.

features.title: Menu ABC analysis
features.text: Which dishes drive sales and which just take up space on the menu.

features.title: Menu matrix (BCG)
features.text: Dishes by sales and margin: what to promote, what to reprice, what to drop.

features.title: Food cost
features.text: Food cost by menu group and venue against your own standard.

features.title: Loss summary
features.text: Six loss channels, from deletions after pre-check to refunds, plus discounts and write-offs, broken down by staff member.

items.name: People & Academy
items.task: Train your team and track how it performs

shot.alt: Training programs in VILAX Academy on demo data

features.title: Team overview
features.text: How many people worked this month and revenue per person.

features.title: Programs and learning paths
features.text: Programs and learning paths by role, from a new barista to the venue manager.

features.title: Tests
features.text: Tests with a question bank that plug into your training programs.

features.title: Knowledge base
features.text: SOPs, checklists, recipes and service standards in one place.

features.title: Achievements
features.text: Badges for completed training and test results.

features.title: Rewards store
features.text: Staff earn points for learning and spend them on rewards.

items.name: Loyalty
items.task: Launch your own program and grow repeat visits

shot.alt: VILAX loyalty club members on demo data: top guests by spend and guest reviews

features.title: Loyalty program
features.text: Members, active guests, points earned and redeemed, and the points liability at month end.

features.title: Loyalty members
features.text: Your program members with spend, visits and last visit for every guest.

features.title: RFM analysis
features.text: Guests by recency, frequency and spend: who to win back and who to keep.
